slug: 2025-05-13 Optimism but uncertainty over Africa's AI Declaration

facts.fact: The Africa Declaration on Artificial Intelligence was signed on 4 April 2025 in Kigali at the Global AI Summit on Africa hosted by Rwanda's C4IR and Ministry of ICT & Innovation; African Law & Business reports 52 of 54 African states signed with the African Union and Smart Africa, only Tanzania and Western Sahara absent, so Rwanda is among the signatories.
